thread:
Ibrahim: quick follow-up from the postmortem on the repeated auth-service degradation. noticed similar symptom-set across Feb/Mar incidents. need concrete owners + jira links so actions don't linger.
Clara: i'll own the investigation (R). creating RWD-9801 now. will post triage notes by EOD Tue.
Evan: i'll take remediation and rollout (A). opening RWD-9802 for the config patch + canary.
Maya: i'll be consulted for alerts & customer comms (C). will draft alert thresholds and a short customer-facing status blurb.
Ibrahim: RACI: Clara=R, Evan=A, Maya=C, Ibrahim=I (pm). sound good?
Clara: short triage: auth-worker crashes when session-cache grows above 1.1GB — seen during bulk-sync jobs. sample log:
```
2026-03-12T04:21:07Z auth-worker error: runtime: out of memory, alloc=1152MB
2026-03-12T04:21:08Z auth-service[pid]: evicted key user:session:* count=12400
```
Clara: suspected causes: unbounded session retention + occasional spike from background sync. next steps in RWD-9801: (1) add TTL enforcement + batched sync backpressure (2) instrument per-session mem histos (3) validate in perf sandbox.
Evan: mitigation plan RWD-9802: (1) enforce max_session_mem=800MB as soft cap, (2) add backpressure on sync with exponential backoff, (3) small canary fleet for 72h.
Maya: alerting: proposing RWD-9803 alert on auth_worker_mem > 850MB for 5m (warning) and >950MB page (pager). will link runbook. also drafting status blurb for customers.
Ibrahim: gating: no cluster-wide rollout until canary mem usage stable and error rate <= baseline for 48h. add gating to RWD-9802 and RWD-9803.
Clara: added gating note to RWD-9801 and linked RWD-9802. tagging ops-bot to create weekly check-in until closure. @ops-bot please schedule a recurring 30m sync.
ops-bot: Created recurring event "Auth-service remediation sync" starting 2026-03-29 10:00 PT, repeating weekly. Invitees: Clara, Evan, Maya, Ibrahim.
Evan: draft PR up, linking RWD-9802. assigning Clara & Maya as reviewers. tiny config change + tests.
Clara: reviewing now. nits in config names but otherwise looks good. i'll approve once perf tests from sandbox are attached.
Maya: once PR merged, i'll update alerting dashboards and ship the customer blurb to comms for review.
Ibrahim: timeline: triage -> PR -> canary (72h) -> staged rollout. target close date: 2026-04-05.
Evan: merging after tests finish. will own canary and monitor.
Clara: will post a short retro note in the postmortem doc summarizing the recurrence pattern and the permanent TTL change.
Maya: i'll watch alerts during canary and escalate if it drifts. :eyes:
Ibrahim: thanks all. leaving thread open for any blockers or changes.
